name: 08093 · Westville, NJ
findings: ZIP 08093 (Westville) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08093 (Westville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08093 (Westville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
